name: Survey tile in Cancer
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.1 degrees south of the ecliptic in Cancer, imaged by SPHEREx 17 times in 5 visits over 25 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 34 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 25 hours starting 2025-10-28, at wavelengths from 1.11 to 4.61 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
